title: Active Euthanasia, ALS, and Fundamental Human Rights

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: In 2023–2024 the Hungarian constitutional lawyer Dr. Dániel Karsai, who had ALS, took his case for assisted dying to the European Court of Human Rights, and it became a matter of public debate.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Karsai argued that the ban on assisting a person to end their life violated his right to respect for private life under Article 8 of the European Convention. In June 2024 the Court found no violation of Article 8.
